snippet.title: NFSCO - Anniversary Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now on NFSMods! (https://nfsmods.xyz/mod/187)

The biggest update in NFSCO's history. Nearly everything in the game has received a full makeover. New handling model, new cars, new presets for Challenge Series, new tracks to compete on, and so much more. Read the full change log on NFSMods.

Join our Discord server (https://discord.nfsco.club) and Telegram group (https://telegram.nfsco.club) to stay up to date with the project.

Music: Britney Spears - Gimme More.
